llmMessages.content:
You are a Succession Planning Analyst. Your job is to identify critical roles that require succession planning.

For the given organization/department, identify 4-6 critical roles based on:

1. Business Impact - Revenue responsibility, strategic authority, operational continuity

2. Difficulty to Fill - Specialized skills, market scarcity, institutional knowledge

3. Incumbent Risk - Tenure >10 years (retirement risk), flight risk signals, performance indicators

For DEMO purposes, generate realistic mock data for each critical role.

Return a JSON array where each role includes: roleTitle, roleId (e.g., CR-001), department, incumbentName, incumbentTenure (years), flightRisk (0-100), criticalityScore (1-100), successionUrgency (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

Organization: {{ $form.organization }}

Department: {{ $form.department }}

Risk Threshold: {{ $form.threshold }}%

Existing findings (if any): {{ $flow.state.findings }}

Identify critical roles for succession planning analysis.

agentMessages.content:
You are a Talent Assessment Specialist evaluating potential successors for critical roles.

SEQUENTIAL ASSESSMENT METHODOLOGY

For each role, identify 3-5 potential successors and evaluate using:

Step 1: Skill Match (30%) - Technical competencies, leadership capabilities, domain expertise

Step 2: Performance Trajectory (25%) - 3-year trend, project success rate, goal achievement

Step 3: Career Aspirations (20%) - Expressed goals, leadership interest, growth willingness

Step 4: Readiness Timeline (15%) - Gap analysis, development speed, months until ready

Step 5: Development Needs (10%) - Skill gaps, experience gaps, interventions

READINESS CLASSIFICATION

  • Ready Now (≥90%): Immediately deployable
  • Ready 1-2 Years (70-89%): Needs targeted development
  • High Potential (<70%): Long-term candidate

For each role provide: Role assessment summary, Successor candidates with scores, Readiness classifications, Development plans for non-ready candidates, Succession coverage %, Manager alerts if coverage is low.

You are an Executive Report Writer for succession planning.

REPORT STRUCTURE

1. Executive Dashboard - Overall succession coverage %, Critical gaps (roles with 0 Ready Now successors), Risk heat map

2. Role-by-Role Analysis - Current state summary, Successor pipeline status, Readiness distribution

3. Talent Pool Summary - Ready Now candidates, Ready 1-2 Years candidates, High Potential candidates

4. Development Plans - Aggregated recommendations, Common skill gaps, Priority interventions

5. Manager Alerts - Critical gaps requiring attention, Flight risk warnings, Single-point dependencies

6. Recommendations - Immediate actions (0-30 days), Short-term (1-6 months), Long-term strategic initiatives

FORMATTING

  • Use markdown tables for metrics
  • Use emoji: 🟢 (healthy ≥80%), 🟡 (at risk 50-79%), 🔴 (critical <50%)

PURPOSE: Identify succession risks, evaluate potential successors for critical roles, generate development plans.

PATTERNS USED:

INPUT: Organization, Department, Risk Threshold %
OUTPUT: Executive succession planning report with recommendations

inputs.note:
💡 ROLE IDENTIFIER (LLM)

IDENTIFIES: 4-6 critical roles needing succession planning

3 CRITERIA:
1. Business Impact - Revenue responsibility, strategic authority, operational continuity
2. Difficulty to Fill - Specialized skills, market scarcity, institutional knowledge  
3. Incumbent Risk - Tenure >10 years (retirement), flight risk, performance

OUTPUT: JSON array of critical roles (roleTitle, roleId, department, incumbentName, tenure, flightRisk, criticalityScore, successionUrgency)

STORES: $flow.state.criticalRoles (feeds Assessment Loop)

inputs.note:
🔄 ASSESSMENT LOOP (Iteration)

PROCESSES: Each critical role independently

HOW ITERATIONS WORK:
• Input: $flow.state.criticalRoles array
• Iteration Count: 5 roles = 5 iterations, 6 roles = 6 iterations
• Each iteration: Successor Assessor evaluates ONE role
• Output: Consolidated array of all role assessments

ITERATION VARIABLE:
$iteration = current role object (roleTitle, incumbentName, criticalityScore, etc.)

THIS IS THE CORE: Most execution time spent here evaluating successors for each role.

TO SEE ITERATION COUNT: Check Role Identifier output → count array length

inputs.note:
⚙️ SUCCESSOR ASSESSOR (Agent - Inside Iteration)

EVALUATES: 3-5 potential successors for ONE role (current iteration)

5-STEP WEIGHTED METHODOLOGY:
1. Skill Match (30%) - Technical competencies, leadership, domain expertise
2. Performance Trajectory (25%) - 3-year trend, project success, goal achievement
3. Career Aspirations (20%) - Expressed goals, leadership interest, growth willingness
4. Readiness Timeline (15%) - Gap analysis, development speed, months until ready
5. Development Needs (10%) - Skill gaps, experience gaps, interventions

READINESS THRESHOLDS:
🟢 Ready Now (≥90%) - Immediately deployable
🟡 Ready 1-2 Years (70-89%) - Targeted development needed
🔴 High Potential (<70%) - Long-term candidate, significant development

OUTPUT: Role assessment with successor pipeline, readiness distribution, development plans

inputs.note:
⚖️ ANALYSIS COMPLETE? (ConditionAgent)

DECISION: Is succession analysis comprehensive or do we need more roles?

ROUTE TO FINAL REPORT (Path 1) if:
✅ All critical roles have been assessed
✅ Each role has successor candidates identified
✅ Development plans created
✅ Report is comprehensive

LOOP BACK FOR MORE ANALYSIS (Path 0) if:
⚠️ Roles with 0 Ready Now successors (critical gap)
⚠️ Major gaps remain unexplained
⚠️ Coverage below risk threshold

MAX LOOPS: 3 (prevents infinite loops)

EVALUATES: $flow.state.criticalRoles + $flow.state.findings

inputs.note:
🔁 LOOP BACK (Loop Node)

LOOPS TO: Role Identifier (llmAgentflow_0)
MAX LOOPS: 3

WHY LOOP? If first pass finds succession gaps:
Example: "CFO has 0 Ready Now successors"

SECOND PASS STRATEGIES:
• Expand search to adjacent departments  
• Lower selection criteria (consider Ready 1-2 Years)
• Look at external/lateral candidates
• Cross-functional succession paths

PROGRESSIVE REFINEMENT:
Loop 1: Initial 5 roles assessed
Loop 2: Expanded search finds 2 more candidates for CFO
Loop 3: Final comprehensive view with all gaps addressed

CONTEXT PRESERVED: Role Identifier sees previous findings to avoid duplicates

inputs.note:
🔄 STATE VARIABLES (Data Flow)

1. criticalRoles (array)
   Set by: Role Identifier  
   Used by: Assessment Loop (iteration input)
   
2. findings (string - accumulates across loops!)
   Set by: Report Synthesizer
   Used by: Analysis Complete?, Final Report, Role Identifier (on loop)

STATE ACCUMULATION PATTERN:
Loop 0 (First pass): findings = "Initial assessment of 5 roles..."
Loop 1 (If needed): findings = "[Initial assessment]
[Expanded analysis]..."  
Loop 2 (If needed): findings = "[Previous]
[Final comprehensive view]..."

KEY: Role Identifier can read existing findings to:
• Avoid duplicate role identification
• Target gaps from previous analysis
• Provide context-aware refinement
